artifact_scan_projection: Raw split JSONs retain all tape-level counts and outcomes; this extraction omits repetitive tape arrays but preserves aggregate raw and paired values and confidence intervals.

dynamic_vs_no_pullback_wilcoxon.scope: episodic signed-rank comparison conditional on common finite predictions

gate.engineering_controls_scope: pre-existing minimum acceptance checks, not a theoretical guarantee
gate.scope: protocol-specific point-estimate criteria; no held-atlas or conditional conformal guarantee

LOAO_OPEN3D.relationship: cross-atlas, same atlas family; not an independent anatomy
LOAO_OPEN3D.measurement_scope: synthetic label-blind ultrasound echoes and tracker poses, not B-mode or robot trials

methodology.pairing: same immutable simulator episode for all six methods; offset levels also share tape seeds
methodology.confidence_intervals: 95% percentile episode-cluster bootstrap; paired draws across methods/offsets; source/station stratified for balanced comparisons, IID for risk
methodology.role_f1: pooled macro-F1 over vessel roles with truth support; argmax predictions, merged truth contributes 1/k per contributor; NULL reported separately
methodology.exact_contributor_mask: argmax over the 64 contributor bitmasks; mask zero is NULL. Accuracy is reported overall, for lumen slots, and by true group size, including 0 for NULL.
methodology.acquisition: fixed simulator truth counts: unique rendered roles per frame, lumen and total echo slots, and empty tapes. These counts do not establish capture of any absent target.
methodology.rendered_fraction_on_finite_slice_truth: fraction of finite simulator slice centers contributing to a lumen echo; not coverage of targets without measured truth
methodology.tracking: world XYZ Euclidean RMSE over all unique rendered frame-role opportunities (including all merge contributors, regardless of predicted identity). Any unmeasured opportunity makes the primary estimate undefined. Conditional finite RMSE, coverage and all-slice results are diagnostics; all-slice opportunities require finite simulator truth.
methodology.paired_tracking: Wilcoxon compares within-episode RMSE on pairs both readers measure; report empty episodes and all missing/one-sided pairs separately. This is not the primary RMSE.
methodology.mcnemar: exact two-sided, one outcome per tape: station argmax, first echo of the terminal frame, or first available prefix echo for retroactive (membership in merged truth counts as correct); empty endpoints are excluded in both arms and counted.
methodology.station: five-way argmax of mean frame posteriors across the acquisition, abstain if unsupported; no test-label masking; macro-F1 over prescribed classes, undefined if any expected class lacks truth
methodology.retroactive: same history replay at midpoint before recheck and at termination; compare decisions on every slot in the prefix. Top-1 membership and exact-mask flips reported separately.
methodology.latency: wall-clock reader.step only, per frame; history relabelling timed separately; does not include simulation, metric extraction or reset
methodology.conformal: Full uses a frozen rank threshold; other readers and the Full nominal control use an unadjusted threshold with no rank claim. Tests compare conditional failures to B3 within each population; there is no rank guarantee for conditional risk, held-source transfer, or acceptance engineering controls. Only rendered lumen identity and geometry can be certified.

offset.offset_axis: commanded circumferential material-arc mm, not achieved Euclidean translation
offset.probe_aim: fixed nominal neutral-skin probe schedule aimed at the training-only trunk; all paired offset levels reuse probe and tracker inputs, and only source anatomy is arc shifted

acquisition.echo_count_policy: counts rendered echo groups by simulator provenance; a mixed group contributes to both ghost and lumen totals

matched_train_source_test.scope: same synthetic source/station mixture as calibration, fresh tapes
